messages:
luke_sales: Prospect sent back a redline overnight. They added an MFN, 12-mo price protection, and a public promo token cap of $0.013/token. POC scheduled Monday. Need quick alignment from deal desk + legal + SE. Excerpt:

```text
MFN: Provider will offer Customer pricing not less favorable than pricing provided to any third party for substantially similar services.
Price Protection: Provider will not raise prices for 12 months from Effective Date.
Promo Cap: Any public promotional price for the Services shall not exceed $0.013 per token.
```

luke_sales: Tagging @tana_dealdesk @rachel_legal @sam_ps @jules_se — timing is tight, customer expects an answer before POC kickoff.

tana_dealdesk: That's aggressive. MFN + 12mo hold = limited flexibility on promos or future rate card changes. Quick thoughts:
- Narrow MFN to "customers with materially comparable committed spend and package"
- Exclude short-term marketing promos (e.g., <$30k) and trial credits
- Convert unconditional price hold into a hosted commit (prepaid credits) for 12 months

tana_dealdesk: If they refuse commit, limit hold to 90 days. If they want full 12mo hold, require a minimum prepaid commit (suggest $150k).

rachel_legal: I can push a counter. Prefer to carve out: (1) beta programs, (2) sales promos under $30k, (3) offers tied to different feature sets (Dedicated vs Hosted). Also make MFN apply only to "sustained commercial offers" (we should define >= 60 days).

sam_ps: Technical flag: their POC runs bursty traffic and will drive token volume. If MFN ties to "pricing offered" regardless of usage pattern, we may get stuck when we later introduce tiered throughput pricing or optimizations. Need a true-up and an MFN linkage to committed units or revenue bands.

jules_se: Quick margin calc: current hosted list = $0.022/token. If we do a 25% commit discount that's $0.0165/token. A $0.013 promo cap is below that band and would hurt economics on high-volume accounts. Example: 8M tokens/mo at $0.0165 ≈ $132k/mo vs at $0.013 ≈ $104k/mo.

tana_dealdesk: Proposal to the customer: 1) Hosted prepaid commit for 12 months with tiered discounts (bands: $50k, $150k, $300k). 2) MFN limited to customers within same package & committed band, excludes transient promos < $30k and excludes beta pricing. 3) If commit < $150k, price hold limited to 90 days.

rachel_legal: I'll draft redline language along those lines and include: MFN only applies to published rate card for sustained offers (>=60 days), carve-outs for promos/trials, explicit true-up for excessive usage during POC, and a clause that Dedicated/private offers are out of scope.

sam_ps: Add a technical true-up: if POC consumption exceeds projected committed units by >25% we reserve the right to re-evaluate pricing or apply overage rates (clearly defined).

luke_sales: Sounds good. I'll tell the customer we have a counter and need a verbal go on commit bands to keep POC start. Can someone share a hosted-commit template I can send?

jules_se: Dropping a short template in a sec.

tana_dealdesk: Escalating commit thresholds to revops for sign-off (cc). Will report back by EOD.

rachel_legal: Marking urgent. Aim to get counter to you in a few hours.

luke_sales: Thanks team. I'll hold POC kickoff notification until we have an agreed verbal on commit structure. :thumbsup:
